question: Who became the first person to swim around the Saint Helena island in February 2026?

function.name: ddg_search

steps.content:
[Jasmine swims around St Helena - Rotary Magazine - February 2026] Jasmine, who in 2022 became the first woman to swim from Land's End to John O'Groats - a Guinness World Record-holding open-water journey of more than 900 miles - undertook the St Helena swim in January during a short stopover for the Mini Globe race on the remote South Atlantic island, following a conversation which took place the day before the attempt.
[Woman's "amazing adventure" as she swims around beautiful St Helena in ...] Diving in head first, Dina claimed the record for fastest circumnavigation swim around Saint Helena (female) in an astonishing time of 17 hr 13 min 28 sec. Her swim, on 26 February, was ratified by Open Water Africa and the World Open Water Swimming Association.
[Dina Levačić becomes the first person to swim 48 km around the British ...] Saint Helena, 27 February 2026 - Outstanding Croatian open water swimmer Dina Levačić has become the first person to successfully complete a 48-kilometre swim around the British island of Saint Helena in the Atlantic Ocean. The start and finish were located near the Landing Steps, and Dina completed the route in 17 hours and 13 minutes.

Dina Levačić became the first person to swim around Saint Helena island, completing the 48-kilometer swim on February 26, 2026, in a time of 17 hours and 13 minutes. 

FINAL: Dina Levačić
